name: intelligent-terminal-mods
description: Claude Code mods for Intelligent Terminal. Each one stands alone; add or remove any of them.

plugins.name: terminal
plugins.description: Tools to see and use the terminal's panes, a note about the user's pane with each prompt, and a Fix line for failed commands

plugins.name: sessions
plugins.description: Every Claude Code session for every other: shared state, slash commands run on request, and a watcher that compacts at good checkpoints
